newsitem.title: UK: Celltech shares lead bouyant biotech sector.
newsitem.headline: Celltech shares lead bouyant biotech sector.

text.p: Shares in Celltech Group Plc were up sharply in Friday afternoon trading, benefiting from a strong recovery in the UK biotech sector as a whole, analysts said.
Shares in Celltech were up 64 pence at 662 1/2 pence, although analysts said there was no fresh news to force the price higher. Celltech shares have risen 38 percent this year.

The company is getting ready to produce late stage trial data on two collaborative projects, a septic shock drug with Bayer AG due in April or May, and a leukaemia treatment with American Home Products, which is due to enter late stage clinical trials around the same time.

Traders said a reiteration by analysts at Lehman Brothers of their bullish stance on Celltech had helped the stock. Lehman believes the shares could reach 10 pounds on positive news for the septic shock treatment, dropping back to 4 pounds if the news is disappointing.
Nomura analyst Nick Woolf, who is also upbeat about Celltech, said however that he would not want to see the share reach the 10 pound level before the septic shock results were published.
Woolf said the biotech sector was benefiting from a general recovery after being "oversold" at the end of last year.
